summary: Resolve opaque process-definition identifiers in instance lists and verify live process existence before reading variables.
userImpact: Active and completed instance lists support engine-generated opaque definition IDs.
Missing or completed runtime processes return not-found for variable reads.

instructions: Upgrade the backend host package or host image through the ordinary release process.

changes: Existing instance-list and variable-read behavior is restored.
OpenAPI now includes the existing tenant-scoped list route with its required engine selector, authentication and error contracts.

security: Authorization, runtime tenant filters and variable redaction are preserved. An engine error is classified as not-found only after a typed parent lookup proves absence.

customerDocumentation.reason: This restores documented instance-list and variable-read behavior without adding user-facing configuration.

knownLimitations: Real engine, browser and protected release acceptance remain required before publication.
rollback: Restore the previous host image using the ordinary guarded deployment process.
validation: Targeted service, route, schema and authorization regression checks.
